name: oxo-flow-varlociraptor
title: snakemake-workflows dna-seq-varlociraptor (port)
description: oxo-flow port of snakemake-workflows/dna-seq-varlociraptor (default-parameter path for one tumor sample group, calling mode variants): vg giraffe mapping against the 1000 Genomes human pangenome, FastQC/MultiQC QC, mosdepth coverage with delly-excluded and covered/expanded region filtering, freebayes and delly candidate calling with filtering, Varlociraptor alignment-properties estimation and variant calling under the default scenario some_id (events present + somatic_tumor_high + somatic_tumor_medium, FDR threshold 0.05, mode local-smart), per-variant-type FDR control (SNV/INS/DEL/MNV/BND/INV/DUP/REP) with merge and phred decoding, VEP annotation with LoFtool and REVEL plugins plus dbSNFP/dbSNP annotation, annotation-based filtering, the 34-column vembrane variant table, oncoprint label-sorting preparation, and the final datavzrd reports for variant calls and gene coverage.
excluded: bwa mapping — non-default aligner branch, not ported
fastp/trimming — non-default trimming branch, not ported
fusions (arriba) — fusion calling is off in the default config (calling mode variants)
MAF conversion — not reachable with the default config
mutational burden and mutational signature analyses — non-default branches
population database (germline AF annotation) — population db is off in the default config
dgidb druggability annotation — off by default
benchmarking — upstream benchmarking rules are not ported
target regions — not part of the default path
template oncoprint views (gene_oncoprint / variant_oncoprints datasets) — empty with the default single group; prepare_oncoprint itself runs
gather_annotated_calls / filter_odds — not reachable in the default path (benchmarking off, filter present only)
upstream scatter.calling(16) chunks beyond scatteritem=0 — collapsed to a single chunk
